_about: Counts only: Peralta's Outcome Outline report (416) on lan.curriqunet.com, from shape trial 45026998155 (S703), ART 001 at each of the four colleges and ART 024 at Berkeley City. Keyed by code and printed college (recall_key), since one code is up to four colleges' pages. The trial's pages and rows are not committed: lan.curriqunet.com is an outcomes-only host, so no reader gate reads this file yet, and RECALL_BY_HOST records it only once the 12-page trial is filed and counted here by eye from its excerpt log (trial and parser_fingerprint moved to that run). Under parser 2629a09a the trial filed 13, 13, 13, 13 and 11 SLOs and no objectives; a reparse of the pages by the section parser filed 5 of 5 as counted.

ART 001 | Merritt College.from: shape trial 45026998155's filed page for course 22154, read by eye apart from the parser: its STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES field to the first CB data-element line, one outcome a pair of lines (the outcome, then its assessment methods); its Student Performance Objectives (Exit Skills) field to Course Content, one objective a line; the college its college-logo image names.
